title: Introduce bridged color grove and proportional gap token set
creator: Ava Moreno
description:
Summary: Propose a new token family called 'bridged color grove' that uses anchored interpolation points for palettes, plus a proportional-gap spacing system and 'radius resonance' scale for corner radii. This ticket covers token definitions, accessibility targets, migration guidance for components (buttons, tables, charts), and a rollout plan with engineering integration notes.

Goals:
- Replace scattered palette ramps with a small set of anchored hues (grove anchors) plus interpolation rules to generate context-aware complementary steps.
- Define a proportional gap system (gap = base * densityFactor) to make spacing scale smoothly between compact and relaxed density modes.
- Introduce a radius resonance scale (proportional radii relative to control heights) to maintain perceived curvature across responsive breakpoints.
- Rework elevation into three layered tokens: micro-halo (interactive), core-depth (surface stacking), and ambient-occlusion (global grounding) with numeric z-index mapping to runtime CSS variables.
- Ensure WCAG AA contrast for primary, success, warning, and danger usages at both default and compact densities.

Design decisions and trade-offs:
- Anchored interpolation over discrete palettes: pros = fewer manual paints, better runtime theming; cons = requires tooling to surface interpolated swatches for designers and reviewers.
- Proportional gaps reduce token count but mean component padding becomes computed at runtime (CSS calc/JS). We prioritize runtime flexibility over static token enumerations.
- Radius resonance ties corner radii to component height (e.g., radius = height * 0.12). This preserves tactile feel but requires component libraries to surface height metadata or expose a CSS custom property.

Accessibility criteria:
- Text-on-primary: contrast >= 4.5:1 for body and >= 3:1 for large text.
- Iconography and status badges must meet 3:1 in compact mode.
- Add automated contrast checks to token CI that run against both default and compact density interpolations.

Migration notes for components:
- Buttons: map existing button fills to new grove anchors, adjust padding to proportional-gap values, and compute border-radius via radius resonance. Provide CSS fallback class .btn--legacy to avoid immediate regressions.
- Tables: row spacing will use gap tokens; hover elevation maps to micro-halo. Chart color ramps should default to the anchored complementary steps to avoid visual collisions in multi-series charts.
- Charts: add palette generator script to produce 6-step series from a chosen grove anchor; document recommended contrast pairings for data labels and axes.

Engineering integration checklist:
- Provide a token generator script (node) that outputs CSS variables and design kit swatches from anchor definitions.
- Add compact density calculation into runtime theme provider (densityFactor variable).
- Update component base styles to read --rwd-radius-resonance and --rwd-gap-proportional.
- Add migration shim in the design-token package to map legacy tokens to new computed values for one release cycle.

Artifacts and references:
- Figma file: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/bridged-color-grove (workspace and page with anchor definitions and examples)
- PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/design-tokens/pull/812 (token generator + example output)
- Eval dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/tokens/grove-contrast (contrast runs across densities)

Rollout plan:
1) Merge token generator + CI contrast checks (ds-2025.3).
2) Release design kit and migration guide to component teams.
3) Ship shims in component library, flag behind feature toggle.
4) Run visual QA and canary rollout on staging product surfaces.
5) Flip feature toggle and deprecate legacy tokens after 2 weeks of monitoring.

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Unexpected color collisions in multi-series charts. Mitigation: Default to precomputed complementary steps for charts and add override knobs for designers.
- Risk: Runtime perf hit from computed CSS. Mitigation: Precompute values at build-time where possible and cache results in theme provider.

Acceptance criteria:
- Token repo includes generator and outputs CSS variables and a JSON swatch export.
- Design kit shows mapped examples for buttons, table rows, and charts at default and compact densities.
- CI contrast checks pass for primary flows.
- Engineering has a migration shim and demo PR merging into component library.

Next steps:
- Schedule walkthrough with ENG infra and component owners (2-3 hours).
- Run a small designer playtest to validate perceived curvature and spacing (3 designers, 1 hour each).
- Finalize variable names and publish migration docs.
